info.name: Wrike API v4 — Capacity Guardian
info.description:
The exact two endpoints capacity_guardian/sources.py calls, with the same query parameters, plus assertions on the response shapes the Python client depends on.

Setup: set the collection variable `wrike_token` to a permanent API token from Wrike (Apps & Integrations > API). The token is stored as a secret-type variable and is never committed — the repo's .gitignore blocks credential files.

The tests here are not decoration. `Tasks — active with effort` asserts that effortAllocation comes back, which is the field the whole capacity model depends on; if Wrike changes that, the Python tool silently starts defaulting every task to 4 hours.
